# LeonardoMD 0.1.606 beta
- Recognizes when the exact installed beta is promoted to stable, with verified publication metadata. About, the footer and Updates preferences show the published maturity while preserving your selected update subscription. - Remembers verified stable maturity when offline and rejects promotion metadata for a different installed package. - Reopens hidden release notes from About and follows the active document theme in the release notes window. - Bounds local document image loading and preview resolution; PDF export requests higher resolution without modifying original images.
Promotion recognition requires this beta or a later supporting build. It becomes observable after this exact candidate is accepted, promoted and its signed publication proof is available. Existing 0.1.571 installations gain this support through a normal update to a newer build.
Cross-device validation remains pending. If an update leaves the previous application instance open, close Preferences and quit LeonardoMD normally before retrying.

# LeonardoMD 0.1.571
## What is new
- About, Release notes, confirmations and file selection now attach to their parent window as modal sheets. File actions reject changes to the active project or workspace while a dialog is open. - Deleted files, folders and projects move to Trash for recovery. - Export Leonardo documents and form answers as Markdown reading copies, with a loss warning and portable images. - Form calendars are larger and follow the active theme. Preview and Split preserve form field presentation. - Undo and redo document edits with separate history for each document. - Configure file colors and filter or sort the project file list. - Little Leonardo is now read-only. Earlier mobile work is preserved for recovery/export; proprietary mobile Git is retired. Desktop synchronization and system Git remain available.
## Compatibility and known limitations
Beta for Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later. Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple.
Native visual acceptance of the new modal sheets remains pending in [#247](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/issues/247).
To receive beta updates, select **Beta** in Preferences → Updates. Stable remains the default subscription.
Update detection and installation are maintainer-confirmed for earlier builds. The active instance can remain open when updating from Preferences. Save your work, close Preferences, and quit normally to let the pending update complete. [Termination issue #202](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/issues/202).
Legacy betas using the former update-signing key require manual installation of a current signed/notarized package.

# LeonardoMD 0.1.405
## Home improvements and fixes
- Browse recent documents, projects and workspaces in separate Home tabs alongside persistent favorites. - Home artwork adapts to smaller windows and appears behind the content. - Avoid duplicate recent projects/workspaces when opening the same folder through different URL forms. Existing duplicates are cleaned while preserving order and favorites.
This stable release predates MDLF, MDLR, MDLZ and Leonardo forms. Choose a beta whose notes include Leonardo document support to try those workflows.
## Installation and updates
Stable for Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later. Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple.
Update detection and installation are maintainer-confirmed. **Known limitation:** the active instance can remain open when updating from Preferences. Save your work, close Preferences, and quit normally to let the pending update complete. [Termination issue #202](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/issues/202).
Legacy betas using the former update-signing key require manual installation of a current signed/notarized package. This is separate from normal update installation and does not mean the current feed is unavailable.
[Publication evidence and validation limits](https://github.com/PinedaTec-EU/LeonardoMD/issues/223#issuecomment-6288007726). Notes clarified on 2026-10-20; original archive, version and channel are unchanged.
